name: OpenVibe.Food

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database is what ready checks)

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are rows in the database, so a person stays signed in across the restart; nothing runs in the background that a restart could leave half done
the OpenStreetMap answer cache is read from food_geo_cache, so a place searched before the stop is not fetched again

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migrations 0001-0002 only create Food's own tables; an earlier release has none to read

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 4970, unit openvibe-food.service. Food near you (food banks and budget grocers from OpenStreetMap through Nominatim and Overpass, one request a second per host, cached 7 days, ODbL attribution on every answer), the budget food list carried over from OpenVibe.Tools with chain-by-chain prices, meal plans for a household and a budget (saved per person), and a pantry with deterministic "what can I make" suggestions. Public reads need no token; plans and pantries are a signed-in person's (or an app token's with the capability). Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client food, JWKS). Owns food_plans, food_pantry and food_geo_cache.

site.name: Food
site.what: Find food banks and budget grocers near you, plan a week of meals for your household and budget, and see what your cupboard can make.
